import asyncio

class Operation:
    def __init__(self, resource):
        self.resource = resource
        self.state = "idle"
        self.started = asyncio.Event()
        self.release = asyncio.Event()
    async def run(self):
        self.state = "running"
        self.started.set()
        try:
            await self.release.wait()
        finally:
            await self.resource.close()
            self.state = "idle"
